page.layout: One page of an index in two columns of entries with page numbers at the right; the title INDEX at the top; section letters N, O, P as headings-like lines; no running head; no page number printed.
page.notes: The blue underlined numbers are printed as hyphenated or highlighted references and are copied as numbers only. Some letter initials (N, O, P) are large decorative capitals; the names beside them are transcribed as printed, with doubtful letters in the first entries of each letter not individually marked. The "D." before Matthaeus and Paulus is printed as a small prefix.
